name: Yuumi
title: The Magical Cat

passive.name: Feline Friendship

description.normalized: Passive: When Yuumi's attacks and abilities strike champions, she heals herself for 67 (+25% AP) Health. If Yuumi Attaches to an allied champion within 4 seconds, they are healed for the same amount as well. (18 second cooldown) Bonds of Friendship: While Attached, Yuumi gains Friendship with her ally whenever they kill a champion or minion. The ally with the most Friendship becomes her Best Fried. Best Friend Bonus: Yuumi's abilities gain bonus effects while she is Attached to her Best Friend.

passive.rawParsedText:
Passive: When Yuumi's attacks and abilities strike champions, she heals herself for 67 (+25% AP) Health. If Yuumi Attaches to an allied champion within 4 seconds, they are healed for the same amount as well. (18 second cooldown)

Bonds of Friendship: While Attached, Yuumi gains Friendship with her ally whenever they kill a champion or minion. The ally with the most Friendship becomes her Best Fried.

Best Friend Bonus: Yuumi's abilities gain bonus effects while she is Attached to her Best Friend.

q.name: Prowling Projectile

description.normalized: Missile Summon: Hold and drag the ability button to steer the missile. Base Effect: Deals 60 / 100 / 140 / 180 / 220 (+20% AP) magic damage. Attached Bonus: If the missile takes at least 1 second to get to its target, its damage increases to 100 / 160 / 220 / 280 / 340 (+35% AP) magic damage. It also slows by 45% / 50% / 55% / 60% / 65% and reveals the target for 1 second. Best Friend Bonus: The missile always slows the target hit. Hitting a champion with the missile grants the ally Yuumi is Attached to 18 / 19 / 20 / 21 / 22 (+5% AP) magic damage on-hit for 5 seconds.

w.name: You and Me!

description.normalized: Best Friend Bonus (Passive): While on her Best Friend, Yuumi gains an additional 6% / 7% / 8% / 9% (+0.02% AP) Heal and Shield Power. Attach (Active): Dashes to an allied champion and Attaches to them. While Attached, she follows her partner's movement and is untargetable except by turrets. Immobilizing effects on Yuumi place this ability on a 5 seconds cooldown.

e.name: Zoomies

description.normalized: Gains a shield that absorbs 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 (+30% AP) damage and 24% / 28% / 32% / 36% (+8% AP) Attack Speed for 3 seconds. While the shield persists, she also gains 20% Movement Speed. If Yuumi is Attached, this ability affects her ally instead.

r.name: Final Chapter

description.normalized: Channels for 3.5 seconds, launching 7 magical waves: While Attached, hold and drag the ability button to steer the waves. Against enemies (per wave): Deals 80 / 100 / 120 (+15% AP) magic damage. Slows by 10% for 1.25 seconds, increased by 10% per wave hit. On allied champions (per wave): Restores 20 / 35 / 50 (+5% AP) Health. Excess healing is converted into a shield instead. Best Friend Bonus: For her Best Friend, the heal is increased to 26 / 39 / 52 (+8% AP) Health. Wave Damage Stacks: Waves after the first deal 20 / 30 / 40 (+5% AP) magic damage. Yuumi can move and cast You and Me! and Zoomies while channeling.
